description: This Java source file defines a utility class `CredentialsConstants` containing constants, enums, and static helper methods for handling credential data within the Credentials API. It includes field names, secret types, hash functions, and methods for constructing search criteria and parsing secret information.

classes.name: CredentialsConstants
classes.description: Final class containing constants, enums, and static methods used throughout the Credentials API.

classes.name: CredentialsConstants.CredentialsAction
classes.description: Enum representing different credential-related API actions such as get, add, update, and unknown, with utility methods for validation and creation from strings.

methods.name: getSearchCriteria
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with search criteria for credentials based on the provided type and authId.

methods.name: getServiceGetRequestAsJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON request object for internal communication with the credentials service via Vert.x event bus.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the hash function used for a hashed-password secret from a JSON secret object.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Extracts the password hash from a secret JSON object, throwing an exception if absent.

methods.name: getPasswordSalt
methods.description: Retrieves the password salt from a secret JSON object, if present.
